format: structure of arrays in boundaries.npz; one entry per shared hex edge

arrays.col_a/row_a: int32 - offset coords of the hex on the plate_a side
arrays.col_b/row_b: int32 - offset coords of the hex on the plate_b side
arrays.plate_a/plate_b: int32 - plate IDs, always plate_a < plate_b
arrays.mid_x/mid_y: float64 km - world coordinates of the edge midpoint
arrays.normal_x/normal_y: float32 - unit normal of the geological boundary, from A into B
arrays.vrel_x/vrel_y: float32 mm/yr - relative velocity v_B - v_A at the midpoint
arrays.vn: float32 mm/yr - v_rel . normal; < 0 convergent, > 0 divergent
arrays.vt: float32 mm/yr - v_rel . tangent, tangent = (-ny, nx); > 0 dextral, < 0 sinistral
arrays.subducting: uint8 - polarity hint for convergent edges: 0 none, 1 plate_a, 2 plate_b
